name: Uttar Pradesh
description: Where Mughal grandeur meets river-side devotion — marble, ghats and old-city bazaars.

name: Rajasthan
description: Desert forts, painted havelis and folklore carried through generations.

name: Madhya Pradesh
description: Quiet stone towns and living weaving traditions, away from the crowds.

name: West Bengal
description: Hill towns, monasteries and a slower, misty rhythm in the northeast corner.

name: Odisha
description: Tribal heritage and landscapes shaped by the Eastern Ghats.

name: Chhattisgarh
description: Bastar's crafts and forest-edge villages, largely untouched by mass tourism.

name: Uttarakhand
description: Mountain paths and valley villages beneath the Himalayan ridgeline.

name: Jharkhand
description: Terracotta temples and forested plateaus with their own local calendar.

name: Delhi
description: Layers of capitals, one on top of another, still legible in the streets.
